body.title: Publish and validate application-only bundle format
body.summary: Advance private ReleaseDescriptor to format2 without runtimeArchive and adapt bundle inventory, ZIP validation and publisher assembly/probes together. Preserve public manifest1, exact source/target/digests and native qualification while separating runtime acquisition inputs from all app/IDE payload collection.
acceptanceChecks: New bundle/publisher receipts and accepted descriptor hashing consistently use private format2; old embedded descriptor1 is rejected diagnostically without reinterpretation or adoption.
Bundle validation no longer requires tools/node or a runtime archive and still validates the exact production app/native closure and archive safety.
Provenance/allowlisted collection rejects ordinary or renamed Node/Ollama distribution/archive contributions; native .node application dependencies remain legitimate.
Publisher runtime probes and candidate preparation obtain the shared verified external runtime; no release-local/PATH fallback or full app/Ollama reconciliation is added.
